description: Energy per site of the released 10x10 Plain network with the three weight-space edits and no training (the 'WSP edits only' column). Each run sampled the attention fill + window head with the head's own phase on fresh mixed-start chains (40 sweeps); the sign rule leaves |psi| unchanged, so its energy is the same samples reweighted to the rule's phase (E_sign_rule). The table value averages the 16,384-chain runs; the post quotes it with an uncertainty of 1e-4.

settings.all: Settings(fill='uniform', fill_heads='nonlocal', local=0.7, window=True, window_avg_units=(3,), sign_rule=True)
settings.12: also rest_fill='dealias', dealias=0.1, rest_heads='all' (a small extra attention-fill rule used only at 12x12)
settings.note: These runs also set head gains and a phase rotor (kappa, kappa_unit3, kappa_phase, rotor). With the window head and the sign rule those act only on the global head's phase, which the rule replaces, so they do not change E_sign_rule. Apart from 12x12, the settings are the fine-tuning start 'ours' in scripts/finetune.py.

cross_check_released_code.command: PYTHONPATH=. python -u scripts/ft_audit.py --zero-shot L --chains 4096 --sweeps 60 --every 10 --fp32 --output OUT.npz; python scripts/analyze_audit.py zsL=OUT.npz
cross_check_released_code.note: The untrained 'ours' start measured with this repository's code (sweeps 40-60 of 60).
